clause.quote: The size component MUST count the Quadlets/triplets in its following group.

inferred_from.inference: A parser should reject a stream in which a count code's group ends inside an element or runs past the end of the stream, since such a size does not count the quadlets of its group.
inferred_from.quote: The size component MUST count the Quadlets/triplets in its following group.

assertions.note: Relies on the adapter protocol's end-of-input rule. Informative class: truncated.

description: A KERI 2.0 inception, then an attachments group holding a -K of one signature, with the last two bytes of the stream removed. The -C and -K sizes promise 22 quadlets of signature and the stream holds 21.5. The adapter protocol makes the end of the input final (a harness rule, not a specification claim), so a parser may not wait for more bytes. The specification states no parser-side rule for this stream; the stream breaks the cited MUST, and the assertion that a parser rejects it is graded SHOULD on the inference recorded in inferred_from.
title: Reject a stream that ends inside a signature
